main.description: Public ATM price record describing amount, currency, and billing cadence for an offer (product, membership tier, or ticket type). Price records are immutable: economics changes mint a new price and repoint the offer defaultPrice.

offerUri.description: AT-URI of the offer record this price belongs to: a money.atmosphere.product, money.atmosphere.membership.tier, or tickets.atmosphere.ticketType in the same repo. Carries no CID: prices point up at their mutable parent; offers pin prices down via defaultPrice.

currency.description: Lowercase 3–16-letter currency identifier. Fiat identifiers use ISO 4217 codes. Catalog values may be stored before a payment rail supports them; chargeability is enforced separately by the configured processor allowlist.

unitAmount.description: Amount in the smallest unit of currency (e.g. cents for USD). Zero means a free/non-payment price: ATM paid checkout enforces payment minimums (recurring subscriptions especially), so zero-amount prices represent free offerings granted outside the charge flow, never a chargeable price. Required for per-unit prices (including customer-chosen amounts); omit for tiered prices, whose amounts live in tiers. When customUnitAmount is enabled, this is the sole default/preset amount shown to the buyer rather than a fixed charge. Matches Stripe Price.unit_amount, which is null for tiered prices.

customUnitAmount.description: Stripe-compatible customer-chosen amount configuration. When enabled, unitAmount should be treated as the default/preset display amount rather than a fixed charge.

billingScheme.description: Stripe-compatible billing scheme. Supper membership tiers use per-unit; tiered is reserved for quantity or usage based apps.

tiersMode.description: Stripe-compatible tier mode when billingScheme is tiered.

tiers.description: Stripe-compatible quantity or usage tiers for future non-Supper apps. Supper membership tiers are represented as separate recurring prices instead.

sourceGeneration.description: Optional app-owned monotonic projection generation. Once present, writers must not replace this record with a lower or unversioned generation.

upTo.description: Inclusive upper quantity bound for this tier, matching Stripe tiers[].up_to. Omit on the final tier (no upper bound, Stripe's "inf").

customUnitAmount.description: Stripe-compatible customer-chosen amount configuration. When enabled, unitAmount should be treated as the default/preset display amount rather than a fixed charge.

minimum.description: Minimum buyer-entered amount, in the smallest unit of currency.

maximum.description: Maximum buyer-entered amount, in the smallest unit of currency.

intervalCount.description: Number of interval units between billings (Stripe allows up to 3 years per cycle, e.g. 156 weeks or 1095 days). Absent means 1, matching Stripe Price.recurring.interval_count.
